note: The parts index: every part an RV is made of, by system, with what it does, how it fails, which RV types have it, which of our guides already covers it, and the phrasings a reader would search. Built 2026-09-29 from Ty's list plus the 110 component makers already catalogued in _data/manuals.json. No models, no specs: this is the index that tells us what content to research next. Each part also carries `makers`: the manufacturers already catalogued in the manuals directory whose documentation covers it, with the archive URL. 36 of 138 parts have a source waiting before any research starts, and a part with makers and no guide is the cheapest content on this list. A ninth system, propane, was added after a completeness check against the manuals taxonomy found the supply side of every gas appliance missing: the furnace and water heater were indexed, and the tank, regulator, hoses and detector feeding them were not. A demand run must MERGE its results rather than write the file back from memory: the first run read _data/parts.json, spent ten minutes measuring, then wrote its in-memory copy over the propane system added while it ran.
